title: Evaluation of the product basis
statement: Let $\Omega$ be a finite nonempty set with probability mass function $\pi$, and let $B$ be a finite Fourier basis on $\Omega$ indexed by a finite nonempty set $\iota$. For every natural number $n$ and every multi-index $a\in\iota^n$, the basis function indexed by $a$ in the product basis is the function $x\mapsto\prod_{i=1}^n B_{a_i}(x_i)$.
hypotheses_covered: $\pi$ is a probability mass function on $\Omega$
$B$ is a finite Fourier basis indexed by a finite nonempty set
